title: known leftover: arm_swipe_beat re-arms a 20 ms timer chain beside the SwipeMachine's own gesture state
trigger: swipe a chat row sideways with the trackpad, then stop sending events mid-gesture
effect: beat keeps waking (50 Hz) until the machine's 600 ms stale rule ends the gesture; ends by itself, no stuck state
fix: drive the swipe settle from the frame clock (request_animation_tick) and drop SwipePoll

title: SuggestUi::dismissed is written on Esc and never cleared, so the same query stays suppressed in later messages and other chats
trigger: type `:fire` (emoji popup shows), press Esc, send the message (or switch chat), type `:fire` again at the same offset
effect: the emoji popup closes exactly at the previously dismissed query and stays hidden until the text changes; stickers_dismissed beside it is cleared when its text stops matching, dismissed never is
fix: hold the dismissal in SuggestStage (e.g. Dismissed{query}) so a stage change, send, or ChatUi swap drops it, like stickers_dismissed

title: CreateRefusal::Own returns from submit_new_community with no note and no Creating step
trigger: Create community, press Create, close the box before the answer, reopen New community for the same chat and press Create
effect: the button does nothing (no spinner, no error) until the first request answers; the later Created outcome only shows a toast and leaves the new box open
fix: on Own, enter CreateStep::Creating with the driver's request (or show the busy note) so the box matches the request that is out

title: settle_scheduled_deletes drops the refetch error after a refused delete, leaving the optimistically removed row gone
trigger: delete a scheduled message while the server refuses (or offline) and the get_chat_scheduled_messages resend also fails
effect: error toast shows but the scheduled list still lacks the message until the box is reopened
fix: hold the refetch as ScheduledLoad::Loading(request) in the box so a failed refetch shows Failed with Retry instead of a silent let _ =

title: ConnectGeneration keeps a u64 generation and a closed_noted: Option<u64> latch beside PollLoop to tell one client's closed note from the next
trigger: replace_client() bumps generation; claim_closed_note compares closed_noted == Some(generation)
effect: no bug today; the once-per-client latch is a counter and an Option kept in step by hand instead of living in the client's own stage
fix: fold into PollLoop/ConnectStage, e.g. Running{_task, closed_noted: bool} so a new client is a new value

title: box open flags beside the box host registry: ChatListUi::archive_hint_open, ChatListUi::downloads_panel_open, CommunityUi::hub_open
trigger: open_community_hub sets hub_open = true then open_box(DialogKind::CommunityHub); close_community_hub clears it; the DialogSpec predicate reads the bool
effect: no bug today; the open state is held twice (the bool and DialogHosts::Asked/Shown) and each opener/closer must write both
fix: one Option<BoxState> per box (or a unit-variant stage in the owner) whose presence is the predicate

title: UndoAction holds its 3 s timer Task and still carries a UndoId counter to ignore old wake-ups
trigger: answer_community_request replaces the Requests undo; finish_community_undo compares UndoId
effect: no bug today: the replaced UndoAction drops its Task, so the old wake-up never fires and the id check is dead weight
fix: drop UndoId; the held Task is the identity of the stage

title: open_chat_look_dialog overwrites an existing ChatLookDialog (and its in-flight Apply acks) when another window opens it
trigger: Apply a chat look in the main window (changes in flight, dialog stays open), then open Chat Colors from a chat window's menu
effect: the single dialogs.chat_look_dialog now targets the second chat and moves to that host; the first Apply's acks are never forgotten and its failure is never shown
fix: forget in_flight() of the replaced dialog, or keep the dialog per window in the WindowSlot

title: confirm_remove_from_community / confirm_join_community_chat / confirm_community_ban take() whatever box is open before matching the variant
trigger: the confirm handler runs while a different CommunityBox is open (e.g. Requests with a pending undo) after a stale button press
effect: let-else returns with the open box already taken: the box closes and a pending UndoAction is dropped without perform_request_action
fix: match on &open first and take only the matching variant, or go through replace_box
